plugin.note: Wear Slayer gloves when attacking Fever spiders or take 12.5% max-HP damage and become diseased. Their defences are low, so any decent melee works; crush (+10) is weakest. Ranged or magic users can exploit the crate safespots with better offensive gloves, and fire spells hit their 25% elemental weakness.

requirements: 42 Slayer is required to harm Fever spiders.
Combat level 40 is required for assignment.
Rum Deal must be started to access Braindeath Island.
Slayer gloves must be worn to attack safely (or take 12.5% max-HP damage and disease).
mechanics: Attacking without Slayer gloves deals 12.5% of max Hitpoints in damage and inflicts disease.
Disease drains stats; Relicym's balm cures it.
Fever spiders have a 25% elemental weakness to fire spells.
They attack with stab melee at 4 ticks with a max hit of 4 (1-12 without slayer gloves).
They are not aggressive and not poisonous.
The brewery basement has many crate safespots (south-west corner noted).

methods.label: Melee with Slayer gloves
methods.summary: Wear Slayer gloves and kill the 11 basement spawns with any decent melee weapon.
steps: Start Rum Deal to access Braindeath Island.
Wear Slayer gloves and fight the spiders; their max hit is only 4.
notes: Their low defences make weapon choice unimportant.

methods.label: Crate safespot
methods.summary: Safespot from the crates (south-west corner) with ranged or magic; fire spells exploit the 25% weakness.
recommendedFor: players preferring offensive gloves over Slayer gloves
requiredOrKeyItems: Relicym's balm (if not wearing Slayer gloves)
steps: Position behind a crate in the basement.
Attack with ranged or fire spells.
Bring a Relicym's balm in case of accidental disease when safespotting without Slayer gloves.
notes: Fire spells hit the 25% elemental weakness.

styleOptions.label: Melee with Slayer gloves
styleOptions.summary: Any decent melee with Slayer gloves worn.

styleOptions.label: Fire spells
styleOptions.summary: Fire spells exploit the 25% elemental weakness from the safespots.
